blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) chief Jesus Fernandez on Tuesday pleaded not guilty to one of his two indirect bribery cases before the Sandiganbayan. The Fifth Division is handling the one count of indirect bribery case involving a ₱10.7 million transaction. The information containing this formal charge was read to Fernandez during his arraignment. READ: Ombudsman orders BFP chief dismissed; graft, bribe raps filed “Director Fernandez pleaded not guilty,” his lawyer Jhufel Brañanola told Inquirer in a text message. This ₱10.7 million transaction is included in the alleged ₱14.7-million bribe that the official purportedly received from businesswoman Rosaverna Sangga. The […]...
